snippet.title: Winter Clothing Tips Every New Parent Must Know
snippet.description:
Are you dressing your baby in too many layers this winter?

Keeping babies warm is important, but overheating can be dangerous, especially during sleep.

In this video, Dr. Shivam explains 5 important winter clothing tips:

1. Dress your baby in layers.
2. Follow the one extra light layer rule as a general guide.
3. Check the chest or tummy instead of hands and feet.
4. Avoid caps during indoor sleep.
5. Follow safe sleep guidelines and avoid loose blankets.

Remember, keeping your baby warm doesn’t mean overdressing!

Dr. Shivam Sharma | Ekami Child Care
